title: repack.config.json
description: The plan written by 'lrun pack', read by go: what to pack, in which order, to which version. Useful hand edits: change a ToVersion, or delete a project before go.

SchemaVersion.description: Shape of the file. Absent in files written before 0.5.1, which read as 1. A version newer than the lrun reading it is refused (config-invalid).

LocalNugetPath.description: The local NuGet feed to pack into, absolute.

RepackTrees.description: One per connected part of the graph; go packs them depth by depth together.

Clean.description: Whether each project is cleaned before its restore (pack --clean).

PackageId.description: The id it is packed under, only when it isn't the name.

SolutionPath.description: The project's solution, whose $(SolutionDir) its dotnet commands get; null when none references it.

Depth.description: From 0: a depth is packed once the previous one is.

FromVersion.description: The base version the plan started from.

ToVersion.description: The version it is packed as.

NotPacked.description: Set by go when dotnet pack produced no package for it (warning not-packed): verify no longer expects it. The next go packs it again and warns again. Absent when false.

ProjectVersion.description: A version split as Major.Minor.PatchAndSuffix: 1.4.3-dev.2 is 1, 4, "3-dev.2".

PatchAndSuffix.description: The patch number, then the prerelease label and build metadata if any.
